featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceeding Expectations: Rane Catering Service Made Our Wedding Perfect!

We were absolutely thrilled to have Rane Catering Service - Lalbaug cater our wedding on November 15, 2025, and they truly deserve the highest praise. From the initial consultation to the last dish served, their professionalism, warmth, and sheer quality of service were outstanding. They were, without a doubt, one of the best decisions we made for our special day.

Exceptional Menu Guidance from Sanket Rane
A special mention must go to Sanket Rane. Selecting a menu for hundreds of guests can be overwhelming, but Sanket’s expertise and guidance were invaluable. He listened carefully to our preferences and budget, offering tailored and insightful advice that ensured the menu was both diverse and perfectly suited to the occasion. His recommendations were spot-on, helping us blend traditional favorites with exciting new dishes, resulting in a perfectly curated culinary journey.
Unbeatable Food Quality, Variety, and Quantity
The food itself was the center piece of the evening, and Rane Catering delivered on every front.

• Best Food Quality: Every single item, from the appetizers to the main courses and the desserts, was prepared with such care. The ingredients were visibly fresh, the seasoning was perfect, and the food was served piping hot—a testament to their meticulous kitchen operations. Our guests are still raving about the authentic flavors and superior presentation.

• Best Variety: The spread was incredible. The sheer variety offered something special for everyone, accommodating different tastes and dietary needs effortlessly. We had multiple live counters, regional specialties, and a dessert section that was both beautiful and delicious.

• Best Quantity: We never once worried about running out of food. The quantity was extremely generous, ensuring that every guest could enjoy multiple servings without the slightest delay.

• Professional and Helpful Staff :
The entire Rane Catering team was remarkable. The staff was unfailingly helpful, polite, and incredibly efficient. They managed the large crowd with grace, ensuring quick service at the counters and prompt clearing of tables. Every team member was smiling, professional, and went above and beyond to make sure our guests felt welcomed and well-attended to.

We wholeheartedly recommend Rane Catering Service - Lalbaug for any major event, especially a wedding. Their dedication to quality, stellar management, and the personalized touch provided by Sanket Rane guaranteed a seamless and spectacular dining experience. Thank you for making our wedding truly memorable!

You can trust them with closed eyes!

Impeccable food n service. The non vegetarian dishes are top notch. Never too spicy or oily but with a good hint of khada masalas that elevate the flavour.

The food is packed with care and hygiene with no spillages here and there.

There is a great variety to the menu and the food always arrive on time which makes it easier to arrange it for the elderlys who live solitude.

My overall experience with Saisha's kitchen has been marvelous.

Of course, there are multiple reasons for ordering so often - scrumptious food, timely delivery, hygienic packing of the food items, ease of communication with Saisha Kitchen, reasonable pricing and many more. I hope you do order their food. You will surely be getting the best!

Thank you, SAISHA KITCHEN.
